title: T1: Tool-integrated Verification for Test-time Compute Scaling in Small Language Models
authors_zh: Minki Kang（KAIST）、Jongwon Jeong（威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校）、Jaewoong Cho（KRAFTON）
paper_type_zh: 工具整合验证器与测试时计算扩展论文（ICLR 2026）
best_for_zh: 设计高效验证器，或在工具检查与语言模型打分间分配推理预算的研究者。
one_line: T1 uses tools to remove memorization-heavy verification work before a small verifier ranks candidates under test-time scaling.
T1 先用工具完成记忆负担重的核验，再由小型验证器进行最终判别，从而提高有限测试时计算下的候选选择效率。
why: It treats verification capacity as part of the inference budget, rather than assuming a stronger verifier is free.
inclusion_reason: It measures how verifier design and tool-backed checking change the value of a fixed test-time-compute budget.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Small language-model verifiers struggle when a judgment depends on numerical calculation or factual lookup, yet replacing them with a large verifier can consume most of the test-time budget.

The paper asks how this allocation should be made so that extra computation improves the final decision rather than being treated as a free afterthought.

小语言模型验证器在判断依赖数值计算或事实检索时容易受限，而用大型验证器替换它们又可能消耗大部分测试时预算。

本文研究应如何进行这种分配，使额外计算改善最终决策，而不是被当作免费的事后补充。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
T1 argues that tool calls should remove checks that external tools can perform before a small learned verifier ranks the remaining candidates.

The central point is to make that choice observable and evaluate it together with the computation it consumes, rather than reporting a detached benchmark score.

T1 认为，外部工具可以完成的检查应先由工具完成，再让小型学习验证器为剩余候选排序。

核心在于让这一选择可观察，并将其与所消耗的计算一起评估，而不是报告一个脱离成本的基准分数。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method filters candidates through a tool stage and then applies small PRM or critic-style verification.

Its record should retain the input, the allocation or configuration decision, all intermediate outputs, the final selection, and the computation consumed by each stage.

该方法先通过工具阶段过滤候选，再应用小型过程奖励或评论家式验证。

其记录应保留输入、分配或配置决定、所有中间输出、最终选择，以及每个阶段消耗的计算。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that tool-integrated verification improves small-model verification and test-time scaling on mathematics and knowledge-intensive evaluations.

This supports the stated mechanism in the reported setup, but it should be read under matched cost and with all auxiliary computation included.

论文报告显示，工具整合验证在数学和知识密集评估上改善了小模型验证和测试时扩展。

这支持了报告设置中的所述机制，但应在成本匹配且计入所有辅助计算的条件下解读。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Compared with a fixed inference recipe, it allocates inference work between executable checks and learned judgment instead of scaling only the language-model verifier.

The contribution is therefore an auditable decision about how to spend inference resources, not merely a larger nominal budget.

与固定推理配方相比，它在可执行检查和学习判断之间分配推理工作，而不是只扩展语言模型验证器。

因此，贡献是关于如何花费推理资源的可审计决策，而不只是更大的名义预算。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Tool availability, execution failures, and task-specific interfaces can dominate the result; a passed tool check does not establish broad answer quality.
工具可用性、执行失败和任务特定接口都可能主导结果；通过工具检查并不等于答案整体质量得到保证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it when parts of correctness can be checked by reliable tools and compare tool cost, verifier cost, and final accuracy under one budget.
当正确性的部分内容可由可靠工具检查时可使用它，并在同一预算下比较工具成本、验证器成本和最终准确率。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Separate the cost of candidate generation, tool execution, and learned scoring; the paper is about allocating those components, not about tools as free supervision.
应分开计算候选生成、工具执行和学习评分的成本；本文讨论的是如何分配这些组成部分，而不是把工具当作免费的监督。
